name: SLAAM Engineering Summer Academy, Rutgers Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering
org: Rutgers School of Engineering, Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering
what_you_do: Do a research project every morning. In the afternoon, work on group design projects. Rutgers engineering faculty and grad student mentors guide you. Bring a Windows laptop.
who_can_apply: Strong high school students, from 8th graders going into 9th through 12th graders about to graduate. You need a transcript. You also need letters from your math, science or engineering teachers.
duration: 2 weeks, 9 am to 4:30 pm (July 6 to 17 in 2026). Non-residential.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed May 1, 2026 (6 pm Eastern). Notices went out by May 18 and payment was due June 7. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online with your transcript and letters from your teachers. Applications that are not complete are not reviewed.
notes: Selective program. Email the coordinator listed on the page if you need help getting a laptop.
